dbus.description: Session D-Bus calls, name ownership and signals in Tarn. Backed by libdbus-1; Linux x86_64.

mongo.description: Pure native MongoDB client driver and BSON engine for Tarn. OP_MSG protocol over TCP sockets; zero C dependencies.

mysql.description: Pure native MySQL and MariaDB client driver for Tarn. Wire Protocol over TCP sockets; zero C dependencies.

postgres.description: Pure native PostgreSQL client driver for Tarn. Protocol 3.0 over TCP sockets; zero C dependencies.

redis.description: Pure native Redis client driver and RESP protocol engine for Tarn. In-memory KV, hashes, lists and sets; zero C dependencies.

sqlite.description: Official SQLite driver and safe C FFI bindings for Tarn. In-memory and persistent storage backed by libsqlite3.
